body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 755322eea7872259bae1cc427b8828674ac3877a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The safety review found no blocking items. Heidenhain, TinyG, and Carvera refuse BORE by name, with or without dwell. This meets issue #1819. The engine counts the message as a warning. The app rejects that warning before export through the single-file, per-operation, and multi-mount paths.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425`:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --no-run`: passed.
- Post tests: 179 passed; none failed. Suite counts: arc_planes 7; comment_escape 3; comp 9; comp_plane 3; expanded_bore_refusal 4; explain_fanuc_family 10; fanuc_post 12; first_traverse_clearance 9; first_traverse_clearance_fanuc_family 9; heidenhain_arc_centre 2; heidenhain_block_form 5; heidenhain_cycles 11; probe_dialects 13; probe_spindle 2; probe_spindle_stop 2; ream_cycle 5; script_carvera 11; script_heidenhain 11; script_tinyg 11; setup_change 28; vertical_arc_entry 3; work_offset_index 9.
- App tests: 42 passed; none failed. Suite counts: carvera_post 4; posting 17; tinyg_post 18; unwritten_post 3.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The initial app build could not write to the compiler cache: `Operation not permitted`. The same tests passed with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=''`.
- The gate dry run passed. Its merge-base selection included unrelated changes from main. The tests above cover the actual PR files.

I repeated three mutation checks locally. For each post, I restored its pre-fix script and ran its named test in `expanded_bore_refusal`. Each test failed with `must refuse BORE with dwell 0: []`. I then restored the fix. Each test passed and checked both dwell values. All three scripts were restored after the checks.

Requested before merge: none.

No golden files changed. No UI files changed. The changed Heidenhain test retains backbore coverage. The decision record states the scope and the reason for refusal. The developer CLI can still show diagnostic program text, as the PR body states. No physical machine test was run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
